description: Ministry of Development Strategies & International Trade - Order to declare that the land in Kuliyapitiya (West), Yatikaha Korale South D/S Division, Kurunegala District is required by the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition, specifically declaring that a particular parcel of land is required by the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka. It includes detailed descriptions of the land's location, boundaries, and extent, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While a government minister is named, the core subject is land acquisition, not a government personnel change or a detailed assignment of ministerial portfolios.
